records = []

    # (id, vessel_ref, tumoroid_ref, clinical_ref, assay_pred, clinical_truth)
    ("P01", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R1C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R1C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R1C4", 0, 1),  # vessel Sensitive (0), tumoroid Resistant (1) → assay prediction inconsistent, clinical Resistant (1)
    ("P02", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R2C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R2C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R2C4", 0, 0),  # Sensitive/Sensitive → 0, Good response →0
    ("P03", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R3C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R3C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R3C4", 0, 0),
    ("P05", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R4C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R4C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R4C4", 1, 1),  # Resistant/Resistant →1, Poor →1

    ("P13", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R9C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R9C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R9C4", 1, 1),

    ("P37", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R16C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R16C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R16C4", 1, 1),

    ("P40", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R19C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R19C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R19C4", 0, 0),
    ("P41", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R20C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R20C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R20C4", 0, 0),
    ("P42", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R21C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R21C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R21C4", 0, 0),
    ("P43", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R22C2", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R22C3", "vision/3c10374ffe09/R22C4", 0, 0),
]

for pid, v_ref, t_ref, c_ref, pred, truth in patient_data:
    # Assay score: 1 if both vessel and tumoroid are Resistant (model predicts resistant), 0 if both are Sensitive (model predicts sensitive), else 0 (inconsistent, counts as incorrect)
    score = {
        "refs": [v_ref, t_ref],
        "aggregate": "max",
        "map": {"Sensitive": 0, "Resistant": 1}
    }
    # Clinical truth: 1 = Poor response (resistant), 0 = Good response (sensitive)
    clinical = {"ref": c_ref, "map": {"Good response": 0, "Poor response": 1}}
    records.append({
        "id": pid,
        "score": score,
        "truth": clinical
    })

# Calculate accuracy manually to verify
correct = sum(1 for d in patient_data if d[4] == d[5])
accuracy = correct / 22
print(f"Correct: {correct}, total: 22, accuracy: {accuracy}")
